description:
What would happen if you spent 24 hours on Snake Island? 🐍

Located off the coast of Brazil, Snake Island is considered one of the most dangerous places on Earth. The island is home to thousands of venomous snakes, including the Golden Lancehead, a species found nowhere else in the world. Because of the extreme danger, the island is completely off-limits to the public.

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
